subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat ship a narrow Copy and Select Copy message action first, or the full Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply action set proposed here?
rationale: Source proves the gap, but Share and Reply add product semantics beyond the central copy/select problem, and the linked fork PR is not a clean same-repository landing path.

options.title: Approve Copy and Select Copy First
options.body: Implement a focused message-level copy/select action surface now, keep scrolling and links intact, and leave Share/Reply for a follow-up product decision.

options.title: Approve Full Action Menu
options.body: Adopt the full Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply scope, accepting the extra composer and Android intent behavior that must be designed and tested together.

options.title: Defer Android Message Actions
options.body: Keep the current code-block-only selection behavior until maintainers choose a broader Android chat interaction model.

recommendation.title: Approve Copy and Select Copy First
recommendation.body: Implement a focused message-level copy/select action surface now, keep scrolling and links intact, and leave Share/Reply for a follow-up product decision.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history on Android chat parity, current ChatMarkdown changes, and the adjacent URL-link fix discussion.
